nixpkgs.expr: let flake = builtins.getFlake "${workspaceFolder}"; in import flake.inputs.nixpkgs { system = builtins.currentSystem; }

nixvim.expr: let system = builtins.currentSystem; flake = builtins.getFlake "${workspaceFolder}"; in flake.inputs.nixvim.nixvimConfigurations.${system}.default.options

let flake = builtins.getFlake "${workspaceFolder}"; pkgs = import flake.inputs.nixpkgs { system = builtins.currentSystem; }; hm = flake.inputs.home-manager.lib.homeManagerConfiguration { inherit pkgs; modules = [ flake.inputs.nixvim.homeModules.nixvim { home.stateVersion = "26.05"; home.username = "conor"; home.homeDirectory = "/Users/conor"; } ]; }; in hm.options.programs.nixvim.type.getSubOptions []
